findings.finding: The 'independent second-profile hydration' alternative does not say that the second profile must authenticate as the same principal and have the relevant organization/access context. A member profile cannot establish hydration of an admin user's note merely by being a second profile. Specify same-principal fresh profile/device for this alternative, or use an authorized exact-ID scoped row read. Keep separate member/admin fixtures and never copy extension storage between them.

The cleanup rule requires cloud confirmation even when the asynchronous save never created a row. In that case a delete update can return success with zero rows and no tombstone, so absence of the exact cloud UUID is the correct cleanup observation, while cloud persistence/deletion coverage stays unverified. Require exact-ID absence or tombstone according to whether a live row was first observed; track any unobserved cloud state as an open limit.
